_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
wolverines: The Wolverines' NAHL season runs mid-September to April at the Sullivan Arena, 28 home dates in Friday–Saturday pairs, with the Robertson Cup playoffs into May; the schedule arrives in July.
seawolves: Seawolves hockey runs early October to March, most weekends at the Avis Alaska Sports Complex on campus and the biggest at the Sullivan, 17 or 18 home dates as an independent; the schedule is out by midsummer.
